description: Planned delivery route emitted by the wadachi route_planning Pregel cell. Captures origin, destination, intermediate waypoints, and the route_planning cell attestation CID (G6 trajectory-determinism — replayable from this record). Cited by trajectoryPlan and missionCompleteRecord. Per ADR-2605242000 (wadachi R0 charter) + constitutional gates G1 (open-source firmware), G5 (Charter Rider §2(a) no armed vehicles), G6 (deterministic planning @10Hz).

routeId.description: Stable identifier for the planned route; referenced by trajectoryPlan and missionCompleteRecord.

vehicleDid.description: DID of the wadachi-orchestrated vehicle assigned to this route.

originCoords.description: WGS-84 lat/lon of the route origin.

destinationCoords.description: WGS-84 lat/lon of the route destination.

waypoints.description: Optional intermediate waypoints in route order.

plannedDurationSeconds.description: Planner estimate; actuals recorded in missionCompleteRecord.

vehicleType.description: Vehicle class; constrained to non-armed civilian per Charter Rider §2(a).

routePlanningCellAttestationCid.description: IPFS CID of the route_planning cell's deterministic trace (G6). Operator can re-run the planner against the same inputs and obtain the same output.

charterRiderComplianceAttested.description: Structural enforcement of G5: the planner must confirm none of §2(a)-(h) is violated by this route (no weapons cargo / no covert delivery / no fossil-extraction servicing / etc.).

firmwareOpenSourceCid.description: G1: IPFS CID of the vehicle firmware source manifest at the time the route was planned.

latE7.description: WGS-84 latitude × 10^7 (e.g. 35.6585°N → 356585000). Per ADR-2605190900 Lexicon convention (integer with implied units).

elevationMm.description: Optional WGS-84 ellipsoidal elevation in millimeters.
